qa_log.question: What is the bid submission deadline?
qa_log.answer: The bid submission deadline is July 9, 2024 at 2:00 PM CST, as extended by Addendum 2.

sources.quote: The new due date for this RFP will be July 9, 2024 at 2:00 PM CST.

qa_log.question: What are the bid bond requirements?
qa_log.answer: Bid bond requirements are not explicitly detailed in the available documents. The RFP references standard district terms and conditions which may include bonding requirements.

qa_log.question: What changed in the addendum?
qa_log.answer: Addendum 1 provides responses to vendor questions covering: USB 3.1 minimum requirement for displays, warranty terms (1 year for Chromebooks, 3 years for Windows laptops), deployment schedule coordination, reference requirements (no proximity restriction), and battery life measurement (manufacturer specs). Addendum 2 extends the submission deadline to July 9, 2024 at 2:00 PM CST.

qa_log.question: What are the evaluation criteria?
qa_log.answer: Evaluation criteria include: samples required only from awarded vendors when ready for large purchases; laptop battery life measured by manufacturer specifications; references do not need to be from Dallas/Fort Worth area (no proximity restriction); USB 3.1 minimum for display ports; warranty requirements (1 year Chromebook, 3 years Windows laptop); deployment schedule coordinated with awarded vendor.

sources.quote: This will be based on the manufacturer's specifications.

qa_log.question: What is the contract duration?
qa_log.answer: The contract duration is not explicitly stated as a fixed term. However, Addendum 1 indicates that quantities will be spread over the life of the contract, implying a multi-year agreement.

sources.file_name: Addendum 1 RFP JA-207652 Student and Staff Computing Devices.pdf
sources.quote: The quantities will be spread over life of the contract.

qa_log.question: What are the insurance requirements?
qa_log.answer: Insurance/warranty requirements include: all warranty options must be official manufacturer warranties; minimum 1-year warranty for student Chromebooks; minimum 3-year warranty for student and staff Windows laptops; Dallas ISD requires warranties to be underwritten by OEM; additional break-fix repair programs are not required but may be offered.

qa_log.question: What is the delivery schedule?
qa_log.answer: The delivery schedule is not fixed in the RFP. Any awarded vendor will need to coordinate a deployment schedule including number of devices per address, device allocation per address, and deployment frequency (weekly/monthly).

sources.file_name: Addendum 1 RFP JA-207652 Student and Staff Computing Devices.pdf
sources.quote: Any awarded vendor will need to coordinate a schedule for deployments. Number of devices to each address, which devices to each address. How many deployments per week, month and when?

qa_log.question: What are the payment terms?
qa_log.answer: Specific payment terms are not detailed in the RFP documents. Addendum 1 indicates that legal terms and conditions (which would include payment terms) are negotiable post-award, with the district requesting removal of any vendor deviations/exceptions to standard terms.

sources.file_name: Addendum 1 RFP JA-207652 Student and Staff Computing Devices.pdf
sources.quote: Will DISD Negotiate the legal terms and conditions after the award of this bid has been made? Answer: If deviations/exceptions to the terms and conditions are submitted, the District will respectfully request the removal of said deviations/exceptions.

qa_log.question: What are the warranty requirements?
qa_log.answer: Warranty requirements: (1) All warranty options must be official manufacturer warranties (OEM). (2) Minimum 1-year warranty for student Chromebooks. (3) Minimum 3-year warranty for student and staff Windows laptops. (4) Dallas ISD requires warranties to be underwritten by OEM. (5) Additional break-fix onsite repair programs are not required but may be offered by vendors.
